title: Use forward CP evolution and a positive logical-identity comparison
statement: The full-state label inclusion parameter is p_boot=exp(C eta T)[u+(1-u)exp(-kappa T)], and native frame-invariant finite OR witnesses give p_out<=b p_boot^(1/k-prime) and an O(N) old raw-potential moment. Logical correctness is supplied separately: forward Duhamel around the nominal CP resets/bath has tail<=exp(C_phys N eta T)[e C_phys N eta T/r_star]^r_star. Low controller excitation plus r_star=floor(zeta N) gives one coherent DATA span of weight q r_star+r_frame alpha N below both distance and LINEAR component cutoffs. The signed low-order map is NOT CP. From the actual positive projected channel A choose sigma=Tr_L A(omega); rho_L tensor sigma is genuinely CP/TNI and differs by<=2epsilon_D. This positive supported O(N)-moment comparison enters the old accepted storage proof without bath refresh or exact reset. It does not physically implement the declared instantaneous switch.
